episodes.title: Emergency Caller
episodes.summary: An anonymous call puts Detective Sergeant June Lenker in the path of the formidable Daniel Hegarty.

episodes.title: Two Calls
episodes.summary: Convinced there's a link between the emergency calls, June sets out to prove a theory—but Hegarty stays one step ahead.

episodes.title: Kid in the Park
episodes.summary: A horrific incident lands June on Hegarty's team, giving her a way to win his trust while secretly digging into the Errol Mathis case.

episodes.title: Protected
episodes.summary: Pressure mounts on June from all sides as she makes a breakthrough in Errol's case.

episodes.title: Possession with Intent
episodes.summary: June's personal life suffers collateral damage when her son is targeted.

episodes.title: Beehive
episodes.summary: A shocking revelation compels Hegarty to find his daughter. June uncovers a game-changing piece of evidence.

episodes.title: The Sixty-Twos
episodes.summary: The events leading up to Errol's 2011 arrest reveal a hidden history.

episodes.title: Carla
episodes.summary: Season finale. A wave of public outrage pushes Hegarty and June to work together before it's too late.

episodes.title: Is It Him?
episodes.summary: The search for a killer lands June back in Hegarty's orbit, who has a proposition for her: Join his intelligence operation to find her man.

episodes.title: Firestarters
episodes.summary: Hegarty brings June into his plan to use Billy as an undercover asset. June's home life starts to unravel.

episodes.title: Snakes and Ladders
episodes.summary: With Billy embedded in Cosmo Thompson's far-right group, Operation Samphire is underway. A key piece of evidence in June's case surfaces.

episodes.title: Safe
episodes.summary: June appeals to the victim's mother to help combat the vicious rumors spread by Cosmo and his followers.

episodes.title: Duty of Care
episodes.summary: Hegarty continues the hunt for the detonators. June comes to a shocking realization. Cosmo's off-the-grid boot camp takes a deadly turn.

episodes.title: When the Music Stops
episodes.summary: After the chaos in the woods, Billy goes dark and Operation Samphire hangs by a thread.

episodes.title: Going Down
episodes.summary: June is calling the shots now, as the team gets information about Cosmo's next move.

episodes.title: Nobody Dies
episodes.summary: Season finale. June and Hegarty must work together to stop the danger already set in motion.
